question: Which of the following sports is played by Vijendra Singh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Boxing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Boxing**

 
 
• Originated in ancient Greece as a sport in the Olympic Games.
 
• Involves two combatants throwing punches at each other with gloved fists.
 
• Fighters are divided into weight classes to ensure fair competition.
 
• Key techniques include punching, blocking, and dodging.
 
• Major boxing organizations include the World Boxing Association (WBA), World Boxing Council (WBC), International Boxing Federation (IBF), and World Boxing Organization
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Football

 
 
• Evolved from various traditional ball games in England.
 
• First codified rules established in the mid-19th century.
 
• Played on a rectangular field with two goals.
 
• Popularized globally and is the world's most-watched sport.
 
• The FIFA World Cup is the most prestigious football tournament.
 
 

 
• Cricket

 
 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC) is the global governing body for cricket.
 
• It oversees both international and Test cricket matches, setting the rules and standards that govern the game internationally.
 
• ICC is responsible for the organization and governance of cricket's major international tournaments, notably the ICC Cricket World Cup.
 
• It also appoints the umpires and officials that oversee all sanctioned international matches.
 
• The organization was founded as the Imperial Cricket Conference in 1909 by representatives from Australia, England, and South Africa. It was renamed the International Cricket Conference in 1965, and then took its current name in 1989.
 
 
 
• Badminton 
 
 
• Originated in India as "Poona" in the 1860s.
 
• Adopted by British officers and named after Badminton House in England.
 
• First All England Open Badminton Championships held in 1899.
 
• Became an Olympic sport in 1992.
